get_default_cpc_config: get the default CPC model configuration with all architecture and training hyperparameters set to their defaults
set_default_cpc_config: set default CPC configuration arguments on an existing argparse ArgumentParser instance
build_cpc_parser: build an argparse parser with CPC architecture configuration arguments including encoder, learning rate, and normalization options
review_cpc_config: review the CPC default configuration to understand encoder dimensions, learning rate, and prediction network settings
summarize_cpc_hyperparameters: summarize the CPC model hyperparameters including hidden dimensions, number of epochs, and sampling type defaults
